visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-up full-bleed product tiles with the image as darkened background and overlaid eyebrow, heading, copy, CTA and optional footnote
visualCharacteristics.summary: 2-up full-bleed tiles with the image as darkened background, overlaid white eyebrow, H3, text and red pill CTA bottom left, optional footnote

cells: Block name plus variant, e.g. Cards (segment)
Rich text (field text): eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link

usage: Product promotion grid (Investments, Lending, Credit Cards, Zelle).
reuseGuidance: Use for product tiles with copy and a CTA over a background photo. An image/logo paragraph can replace the heading.
